text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel came to spectate the Hanshin 
Daishoten— to bear witness to the 
unwavering, heroic strength of Narita 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with a breathtaking run, Narita Brian 
seized 1st place. The crowd's excitement 
reached a fever pitch, with voices already 
whispering, "Could the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe be next?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her idol is far ahead—and that's precisely 
why she wants to overtake her. Sakura 
Laurel resolves in her heart to one day 
surpass Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, news arrived that Narita Brian 
had suffered an injury and would skip the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Even so, Sakura Laurel 
kept her eyes fixed straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't halt her strides while Narita 
Brian rests. Intending to close the gap in 
the meantime, she sets her sights on the 
"Tenno Sho (Spring)" as planned.
